alignments.note: Verb with subject pronoun and auxiliary (rule 17), discontinuous around the negative (rule 25).
The supplied definite article belongs to the nominal expression it determines (rule 15).
Temporal בְּ + infinitive construct recast as a finite clause; the preposition takes the *when* (rule 52).
Infinitive with its phrasal particle; the head stays on the lexical verb (rule 44).
The suffix on an infinitive construct is its subject and takes the English subject pronoun (rule 18).
The italic *the grain* is an object the Hebrew does not write; no morpheme licenses it (rules 30, 44).

review_notes: The ASV italic on *the grain* corroborates the `added` reading without deciding it (rule 7).
